name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Curl
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand at your side with your palm facing forward.
Keep your upper arm tucked close to your ribs and curl the dumbbell upward toward your shoulder by bending only at the elbow.
Pause briefly at the top while squeezing your biceps firmly.
Lower the dumbbell until your arm straightens, then switch sides.
tips: Avoid swinging your torso or leaning sideways to heave the weight upward.
Keep your wrist straight and your elbow stationary at your side throughout each repetition.
